evals.name: Scan and Identify Duplicate & Fragmented Clusters
evals.prompt: Scan the ai-agent-toolkit repository for overlapping skills or duplicate rules and report consolidation candidates.
evals.expected_output: Heuristic repeated-name and topic-prefix report identifying manual consolidation candidates, not proven semantic duplicates.
assertions: Runs scripts/scan_duplicates.py against a specific target or the toolkit repository
Clusters names by filename prefixes and marks them as manual-review candidates
Does not scan excluded tools/generators/ and auxiliary directories when targeting the toolkit root

evals.name: Execute Zero-Loss 5-Pillar Skill Consolidation
evals.prompt: Consolidate two fragmented skills in the repository into a single master 5-pillar skill bundle without losing unique knowledge.
evals.expected_output: Human-reviewed refactoring proposal preserving unique references, scripts, assets, eval cases and Gotchas before any deletion.
assertions: Follows the four-stage human-reviewed merge protocol with explicit user approval before deletion
Preserves all unique instructions, code examples, schemas, and Gotchas in the master bundle
Validates the master skill bundle with validate_skill.py and runs evals
